page_annotations: Ink blot at the top edge, stray dots at the left, and faint mirrored show-through from the reverse; none of this is target writing.
Text beyond the gutter (about x3175) belongs to fol. 256 and is not transcribed here.

coverage.finding: The ink folio number '255' with a raised 'b' and a following dot is at the top left. The candidate reading '255ᵇ.' matches the image.
The faint pencil 'ū/' with a separate '?' is at about y900-1070. It stands level with the fol. 256 entry 'Vd.143 (6)'. The attachment is unproven and the letter reading is uncertain.
The ink note 'Scribe Kamatā Kāntadevaśarman.' is level with the fol. 256 left-pointing arrow at 'b. 99 (4)'. The reading of the first name is uncertain.
Two pencil groups, 'ś/' and 's/', are level with fol. 256 'd. 407'. The readings and the attachment are uncertain.

The two-line ink note is present. In line 2, the cancelled 'near end' after 'to' carries an interlinear 'middle' written above it. The candidate wrote this insertion as a bracketed description inside literal_text; this is corrected below. The superscript ordinals '10th' and '25th' are raised in the source.
The query mark sits below 'ff. ka to na' at the end of line 1, between the two lines and at the far right. Grouping it with r005 is reasonable.

The single ink line is present, with a left-pointing arrow near the gutter and a small tick below '133'. It is level with the fol. 256 'Vd. 68' entry, which has the bracket and 'lit s. Vāj. S.' annotation.
